recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. Further JSON Schema generator changes, if any are needed later, should be made in Kindling or the publisher dependency workflow rather than by editing generated JSON Schema artifacts in core.
issue_request: Published/Persuasive FHIR-core issue requesting that generated FHIR JSON Schema objects include "type": "object" because validators such as gojsonschema otherwise accepted arrays or strings; the description also noted possible "type": "string" typing for enums.
initial_application: The active core checkout does not contain a checked-in fhir.schema.json source. JSON Schema is exposed as a current download from source/downloads.html and generated through the Gradle Kindling dependency. HL7/kindling commit 11734e357e18bf0ed296c29fa287257872fb1f88 applied FHIR-24850 by adding r.addProperty("type", "object") in JsonGenerator.generateType.
additional_context: FHIR-I minutes from 2020-03-23 corroborate the Persuasive 12-0-0 vote. The current core build uses kindlingVersion=1.25.5-SNAPSHOT, and the current build.fhir.org JSON Schema zip has zero object-like definitions missing type object and zero enum definitions missing type string. Corrected Zulip and Confluence searches found no conflicting discussion beyond the FHIR-I vote minutes.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit on the combined branch. The current core build is already wired to the fixed generator and the generated schema surface satisfies the requested behavior.

related_jiras.note: An older Published JSON Schema fix surfaced in Jira search, but it concerns separate combined/ResourceList schema fixes and was not needed to decide FHIR-24850.
